title: Parameterization-Invariant 1-Loop Graviton Focusing, Topological Prolate Stabilization, and Anisotropic Berger-Sphere Casimir Dynamics on S^3/Gamma

conventions.units: Reduced Planck units 8*pi*G_N = M_Pl^-2 = 1, c = 1, hbar = 1; unreduced Planck length l_P = sqrt(G_N*hbar) = l_Pl / sqrt(8*pi); pure-gravity Dvali species scale (N_sp = 2, per CLM-T3-01 and CLM-P2-03) l_sp^red = sqrt(2)*l_Pl = 4*sqrt(pi)*l_P = 7.089815 l_P
conventions.coframe: Left-invariant orthonormal coframe d(omega^a) = -eps_abc omega^b ^ omega^c, [X_a, X_b] = 2 eps_abc X_c, dvol = +omega^1 ^ omega^2 ^ omega^3
conventions.berger_metric: ds_3^2 = a_perp^2 [(omega^1)^2 + (omega^2)^2 + lam_B^2 (omega^3)^2] = a_bar^2 [lam_B^(-2/3)((omega^1)^2+(omega^2)^2) + lam_B^(4/3)(omega^3)^2], fixed-volume radius a_bar = (a_perp^2 a_3)^(1/3), squashing lam_B = a_3/a_perp, Vol(S^3_lam/Gamma) = 2*pi^2*a_bar^3/|Gamma|
conventions.renormalization_scheme: Topological Casimir difference u_top(Gamma; lam_B) = u(S^3_lam/Gamma) - u(S^3_lam) via Kahan-compensated Schwinger Gaussian heat-kernel regulator (1/2)*w*exp(-t*w^2), supplemented by exact covariantly conserved fixed-mu local Berger-S^3 renormalized energy u_ren(S^3_lam; mu) for the 3D-TT operator Delta_L^(3D) with Seeley-DeWitt coefficients B_0 = 1/4, B_2 = -(7/48)*R^(3), A_4 = 2*B_4 = (-5/192)*(R^(3))^2 + (63/320)*C_(4)^2 and exact trace anomaly T^u_u = +A_4(lam)/(pi^2*a_bar^4)

matched_controls.matched_components: Identical 1-parameter metric family g_ij^(alpha) = a^2(gamma_ij + h_ij + alpha*(h^2)_ij) across 6 alpha values in [-1, 1.5], exact nonlinear 4D Einstein tensors and nonlinear null geodesics
matched_controls.treatment_result: On curved global dS_4/Gamma (K=+1), background backreaction Delta_eta_BR(alpha) varies by 24.4% to 37.7% (26.7% on S^3/I*) between FP (alpha=1/2) and linear (alpha=0), cancelling to 1.71e-49 against exact inverse-metric/geodesic Delta_eta_LC(alpha). Curved-S^3 triaxial Bianchi IX (p=3) geodesic integration confirms exact -alpha/6 slope invariance (err 3.09e-09) with Schur-complement offset +0.149528 vs 3/20 = 0.150000.
matched_controls.control_result: On flat K=0 space (H=0), delta_rho_alpha === 0 and delta_P_alpha = 2*Phi_alpha'' averages to zero under Isaacson averaging; exact Sachs-Einstein identity -R_uv^(2) k^u k^v === sigma^2 + d(delta_theta^(2)_alpha)/dlam holds to 8.71e-24, and general-angle nonlinear Gowdy fixed-endpoint shooting (including phi=pi/4) verifies exact S^2 average (1-alpha)/6 to <= 4.98e-08.
matched_controls.conclusion: The Ford-Parker vs linear-metric backreaction discrepancy is a curved-spacetime metric-parameterization artifact that cancels identically in physical geodesic observables with zero double-counting of gravitational-wave shear focusing; including the alpha-independent Schur-complement metric-shear term (+1/10 <h^2>) shifts N_V^crit(I*) from 4 to 5 (Schur baseline, x=4.8208) or 6 (full 2nd-order WKB geodesic, x=5.0328).

matched_controls.matched_components: Identical 4-variable pure-GR + Lambda and 6-variable Starobinsky f(R) (sigma_t=4.0) axisymmetric Bianchi IX ODEs (DOP853 and Radau, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-14)
matched_controls.treatment_result: High-order Class 4b quotients drive dynamical oblate collapse to the Lichnerowicz wall lam_B = 0.525 strictly inside the super-species EFT domain (L_min/l_sp^red > 1 throughout the trajectory) on pure-GR + Lambda bounces: L(24,1) hits lam=0.525 up to a_b = 44 l_P (min L_min/l_sp^red = 1.619), D_12* up to a_b = 44 l_P (min L_min/l_sp^red = 1.618); by contrast Class 4a quotients (L(11,1), D_6*, L(14,1)) cross L_min/l_sp^red < 1 and are sub-species.
matched_controls.control_result: Round S^3 negative control (u_top === 0, perturbed to lam_0 = 0.98) and isotropy-irreducible Q_8 (lam_0 = 0.98) remain strictly stable with damped classical shear oscillations returning toward lam_B = 1.
matched_controls.conclusion: Dynamical oblate collapse is driven purely by the anisotropic O(q^4) pure-graviton Casimir torque, with genuine super-species runaway (L_min/l_sp^red > 1 all the way to lam_B = 0.525) commencing at L(16,1) (a_b = 19 l_P, min L_min/l_sp^red = 1.047) and becoming deeply super-species on L(20,1)/D_10* and L(24,1)/D_12* (min L_min/l_sp^red = 1.62) after correcting the Dvali species scale to l_sp^red = sqrt(2)*l_Pl = 7.090 l_P.

matched_controls.matched_components: Identical finite-lam_B quotients comparing traceless u_top(Gamma; lam_B) alone against exact covariantly conserved fixed-mu u_tot = u_top + u_ren(S^3_lam; mu) with trace anomaly T^u_u = +A_4(lam)/(pi^2*a_bar^4)
matched_controls.treatment_result: Topological-only u_top exhibits shallow O(1) curvatures on Q_8 (+2.97), L(6,1) (-2.17), D_3* (+2.99), L(3,1) (-7.32), moderate destabilization on Class 4a L(11,1)/D_6*/L(14,1), and massive O(q^4) curvature on Class 4b L(20,1) (-2059.3), L(24,1) (-4345.8), D_12* (-4325.1).
matched_controls.control_result: Universal 3D-TT Berger-S^3 local renormalized energy has pi^2*u''_ren(S^3; 1; mu) = +67.64 -36.9334*ln(mu*a_bar) (exact A_4''(1) = +554/15 = +36.9333; 2-decade band [-17.41, +152.68]), which overwhelms shallow O(1) topological wells on Q_8, L(6,1), D_3*, L(3,1) while being overwhelmed 13.5x on L(20,1) and 28.5x on L(24,1). Dynamically on L(24,1) at a_b=42 l_P, all three fixed-mu scales mu*a_b in (0.1, 1.0, 10.0) hit the Lichnerowicz wall lam=0.525 with min L_min/l_sp^red > 1.
matched_controls.conclusion: Linearized equilibrium directions u'_top(1) are 100% scheme-independent (SO(4) isotropy u'_ren(1)===0); shallow finite-lam_B wells on Q_8/L(6,1)/D_3*/L(3,1) are O(1) scheme-sensitive; high-order O(q^4) oblate runaway (q >= 14 statically; q >= 16 dynamically super-species) is robustly insensitive across a full 2-decade RG scale sweep.

matched_controls.treatment_result: Spin-2 gravitons exhibit the universal oblate Lichnerowicz wall lam_oblate = 1/2, divisor-arithmetic prolate walls, quantum-reinforced roundness on Q_8 (u''_S2(1) = +2.972 > 0), and prolate-pulling slopes on L(6,1) (-1.987) and D_3* (-1.830).
matched_controls.control_result: Spin-1 Maxwell has min |omega| = +0.2000 across 2j<=40, lam in [0.10, 6.00] (ZERO tachyons for all lam_B > 0), OPPOSITE-SIGN destabilizing curvature on Q_8 (u''_EM(1) = -3.367 < 0), and OPPOSITE-SIGN oblate-pulling slopes on L(6,1) (+4.148 > 0) and D_3* (+3.148 > 0), while converging asymptotically within 3% of Spin-2 at high order L(24,1) (u''_EM = -4477.9 vs u''_S2 = -4345.8).
matched_controls.conclusion: The Lichnerowicz instability walls (KT2), Class 1 Q_8 round reinforcement, and Class 2 L(6,1)/D_3* prolate attraction are uniquely spin-2 curvature-coupling effects, whereas asymptotic O(q^4) Class 4b oblate destabilization is universal to 2-helicity massless bosons but uniquely terminates at the spin-2 Lichnerowicz wall lam_B -> 1/2.

General-angle nonlinear Gowdy geodesic shooting (including phi=pi/4) verifies the exact S^2-averaged fixed-endpoint shift (1-alpha)/6 to <= 4.98e-08, revealing the alpha-independent Schur-complement metric-shear term (+1/10 <h^2>) missed by a straight coordinate line (-alpha/6 + 1/20). domain_of_validity.regime: 1-loop semiclassical pure-vacuum-GR graviton QFT on global dS_4/Gamma (ADE space forms) and squashed Berger-sphere quotients S^3_{lam_B}/Gamma (L(q,1) and S^3/D_m*) in the super-species EFT domain L_min(a_bar, lam_B) > l_sp^red = sqrt(2)*l_Pl = 7.090 l_P, sub-Planckian curvature R < M_Pl^2, and inside the Lichnerowicz stability window 1/2 < lam_B < lam_prolate(Gamma).
caveats: Dvali Species-Scale Threshold: Under CLM-T3-01 / CLM-P2-03, pure gravity (N_sp = 2) has l_sp^(2) = sqrt(2)*l_Pl = 4*sqrt(pi)*l_P = 7.0898 l_P. Consequently, Class 4a quotients L(11,1), D_6*, and L(14,1) lie in the sub-species regime at their destabilization radii (static L_min/l_sp^(2) = 0.697, 0.763, 0.939 < 1); genuine super-species static destabilization begins at L(16,1) (L_min/l_sp^(2) = 1.092), and genuine dynamical oblate runaway remaining super-species all the way to the Lichnerowicz wall lam_B = 0.525 also begins at L(16,1) (a_b = 19 l_P, min L_min/l_sp^(2) = 1.047) and becomes strongly super-species across L(20,1)/D_10* (min L_min/l_sp^(2) = 1.32) and L(24,1)/D_12* (min L_min/l_sp^(2) = 1.62).

2nd-Order Geodesic Crossover N_V^crit(I*) in {5, 6}: Including the strictly alpha-independent Schur-complement metric-shear term (+1/10 <h^2> in sqrt(g^nn)) shifts the total parameterization-invariant null-cone delay on S^3/I* from the incomplete straight-line estimate (x=3.5486, N_V^crit=4, retracted) to x = 4.8208 (N_V^crit = 5, Schur-complement geodesic baseline) and x = 5.0328 (N_V^crit = 6, full 2nd-order fixed-endpoint WKB geodesic including flat-space Fermat +1/40 and longitudinal redshift -1/120). Because the exact curved-S^3 mode-by-mode Fermat coefficient c_geo(p) on global dS_4/I* is verified for p=3 (Bianchi IX, +0.149528 vs Schur 0.150000) and asymptotically via WKB (1/6), the exact integer crossover is bounded honestly as N_V^crit(I*) in {5, 6}.

3D-TT Non-Einstein Operator Truncation, 6 Broken CKV Modes, and Scheme Sensitivity: On static non-Einstein R_t x S^3_lam (lam != 1), the 3D-TT Lichnerowicz operator Delta_L^(3D) omits O((lam-1)^2) coupling to 4D background-stress / vector-scalar gauge constraints, so c_C = 63/320 and A_4''(1) = +554/15 = +36.9333 characterize the 3D-TT operator specifically. Retaining the 6 broken round-S^3 Killing/CKV modes via continuous_s3=True (2j=0,|2M|=2 and 2j=1,|2M|=1; u_6''(1) = +4.510) preserves exact SO(4) continuity at lam=1 and cancels identically in u_tot = u_top + u_ren(S^3) for every L(q>=3,1) and D_m*. Shallow O(1) topological wells on Q_8, L(6,1), D_3*, L(3,1) are O(1) scheme-sensitive to C^2 counterterms, whereas q >= 14 is unconditionally 2-decade scheme-robust.

Quasi-Static Adiabatic Stress-Tensor Approximation, Starobinsky N_sp = 3 Species Scale, & Omitted Scalaron Casimir Energy (KT4): Dynamical Bianchi IX ODEs evaluate the quasi-static finite-lam_B graviton stress tensor (including exact covariantly conserved fixed-mu trace anomaly) instantaneously along (a_bar(t), lam_B(t)), omitting dynamical pair creation proportional to (d(lam_B)/dt)^2 that becomes O(1) as lam_B -> 0.50 (where omega_{0,0} -> 0); ODEs halt honestly at lam_B = 0.525. Starobinsky f(R) bounces at a_b = 10 l_P have super-Planckian curvature R_0/M_Pl^2 ~ 3.6 > 1 (outside EFT). Because Starobinsky f(R) propagates N_sp = 3 gravitational degrees of freedom (2 graviton helicities + 1 scalaron of mass M_S = M_Pl/sqrt(2*sigma_t) = 0.354 M_Pl), its Dvali species scale is l_sp^(3) = sqrt(3)*l_Pl = 8.683 l_P, and our runs omit the 1-loop massive-scalaron Casimir energy; under l_sp^(3), L(24,1) and D_12* at a_b = 36 l_P (R_0/M_Pl^2 = 0.59 < 1, 2*sigma_t*r_0 = 0.78 < 1) still undergo strictly super-species oblate runaway (min L_min/l_sp^(3) = 1.067 and 1.066 > 1), whereas L(20,1) at a_b = 24 l_P (0.868) and L(24,1) at a_b = 44 l_P (0.878) fall below l_sp^(3).
